47. It is also the case of the Defendants that the words "ASR PARAS", "PARAS BRIGHT" and "PARAS JUNA" are in distinctive manner and are not deceptively similar in anyway to the marks of the plaintiff.
It is stated that the word "PARAS" is a common dictionary name.
It is further stated that the Font size and color scheme of the Defendants' products are also different.

48. It is further submitted that the theme of the products may be same but the presentation and creation of the same are different and subsequent work becomes a completely new work, hence no question arises of violation of copyright as well.
49. Section 2(1)(h) of Trademark Act deals with deceptive similarity which reads as under:
"A mark shall be deemed to be deceptively similar to another mark if it so nearly resembles that other mark as to be likely to deceive or cause confusion".
